method: Saved MuseumStart Play Mode; queued synthetic tracked left/right controllers and HMD in ordinary Dynamic Input System updates through production Input Actions and XRDirectInteractor. Rays are disabled only in the transient Play Mode scene to isolate Direct. TestPose converts actual palm envelopes to controller poses and routes around solids. No direct SelectEnter/SelectExit, manual InputSystem.Update, asset saves, filter removal or generator calls. Public reset/window APIs establish independent fixture preconditions. A temporary solid blocker tests existing obstruction rejection.
limitations: Synthetic controller input is not real headset/controller, comfort/reachability, user-study or executable-build validation. This focused runner complements the separate saved-scene ray/API regression.
